items.content_html: DeployNow is a lightweight deployment platform like Vercel. It automates Docker builds from GitHub repos, pushes images to AWS ECR, and runs them on ECS. Built with Node.js, Express, Supabase, and BullMQ, it supports background jobs, and works within AWS free tier limits.

Built with Node.js, Express, Supabase, and BullMQ, it supports background jobs, and works within AWS free tier limits.

items.content_html: lupine.js is a full-featured web application that includes both Front-End and Back-End services. The Front-End, lupine.web, is an extremely lightweight framework using React TSX syntax. The Back-End, lupine.api, is a highly efficient and simplified framework similar to Express. It supports server-side rendering from scratch.
